item.title: Southwestern Public Health investigating after dog bites person in face in Tillsonburg
item.description: Southwestern Public Health is appealing to the public for help after an individual was bitten in the face by an off-leash dog at Coronation Park in Tillsonburg.

item.title: 14-year-old snowmobile operator dies in two-vehicle collision in Oxford County
item.description: Oxford County OPP is investigating a Saturday snowmobile collision that claimed the life of a 14-year-old. Provincial police and emergency services responded to a report of a collision involving a snowmobile and a pick-up truck on Road 92 and 23rd Line in Zorra Township at 10:30 a.m. The 14-year-old operator of the snowmobile was transported […]

item.title: 'Port Dover will feel this change': Community reacts after contract not renewed for grocery store franchisees
item.description: Community members are questioning a decision by Loblaws to replace the operators of the town’s No Frills store.

item.title: Animals perish in barn fire near Port Dover
item.description: Several animals were killed in a barn fire at a St. John's Road East address in Port Dover on Saturday, Norfolk County fire officials say.

item.title: Five candidates vying for Ward 5 seat on County of Brant council
item.description: Five candidates will be vying to fill a vacant seat on the County of Brant council. A byelection will be held on March 16 to take over the Ward 5 seat left vacant when former councillor Christine Garneau resigned in October, citing “an irreconcilable conflict” between her municipal duty and her business’s “best interests.” Registered candidates are environmental advocate and Langford/Jerseyville area resident Ella Haley; […]

item.title: Brant OPP: County resident charged with uttering threats
item.description: A 37-year-old Brant County resident has been charged following an investigation into intimate partner violence. Brant County OPP responded on Saturday morning after a county resident reported receiving threatening messages. item.title: Suspected drug-related deaths in Brantford-Brant drop to lowest level since 2018
item.description: The rate of suspected drug-related deaths and emergency room visits due to opioid-related poisoning in Brantford Brant has dropped to its lowest level since 2018.
